ogulcancelik/herdr-plugin-examples.note: 公式のサンプル集。コピー元として使う想定で、メンテされた公式プラグインではない

owner/repo-example.note: 書き方の例。存在しないリポジトリは無視される

riq0h/tab-blank-number.description: herdr plugin that clears herdr's default numeric tab labels (1, 2, 3…) to blank.

riq0h/tab-process-name.description: herdr plugin that labels each tab with its foreground process name — tmux's automatic-rename behavior, for herdr.

aashishd/herdr-agent-messenger.description: Send focused, self-contained messages between AI agents running in live Herdr panes, so one agent can coordinate work with another without sharing its full context.

darjss/herdr-orchestrate.description: Pi-native orchestration for visible Herdr worker sessions — a run board, durable prompts/reports/state, isolated git worktrees, and explicit model routing.

krystof018/herdr-git-status.description: Surfaces CI status inside herdr for both GitLab (pipelines + merge requests) and GitHub (Actions + pull requests), auto-detected from the repo's origin.

lachieh/herdr-plugin-cmux.description: Mirrors every herdr-managed agent into a cmux sidebar as its own live row, with a status pill and a click-to-jump task line.

aclima01/herdr-edit-windows.description: A simple text editor that runs in a herdr pane beside your coding agent — file tree, syntax-highlighted editor, and an uncommitted-diff tab. Windows-only.

HikaruEgashira/say-hook.description: A macOS CLI that reads Claude Code hook events aloud using ElevenLabs text-to-speech.

Allianaab2m/herdr-hunk-gh-diff.description: Herdr plugin: open a Hunk diff between the branch checked out in the current pane and the target branch of its GitHub pull request.

gilvanecesar/herdr-attach.description: Pick local files from a Herdr popup and send them to the focused coding agent, attaching file context without leaving the terminal.

maedana/herdr-agents-bridge.description: Monitor and interact with your coding agents from your phone via a local mobile-friendly web UI — connect by scanning a QR code.

maedana/herdr-agents-preview.description: Multi-agent terminal preview dashboard for Herdr: all running agents shown at once, with the selected agent taking most of the width.

maedana/herdr-agents-status.description: Always-on-top transparent overlay showing Herdr agent status — a spiritual successor to claudeye, built for Herdr instead of tmux.

maedana/herdr-hint.description: Vimium-style hint labels for Herdr — press a key to see labels on tabs and agents, then press a label to jump.

maedana/herdr-whereami.description: Herdr plugin that automatically renames tabs to show where you are, e.g. repo-name/branch when inside a git repository.

MartinBspheroid/herdr-agent-dash.description: Herdr Agent Board: a local, keyboard-first plugin for scanning active coding agents, their state, working directory, and Git context at a glance.

OiAnthony/herdr-plugin-telegram-notify.description: Standalone Herdr plugin that sends Telegram notifications when an agent is done or blocked.

Qu4tro/herdr-whichkey.description: A blezz/which-key-style action menu for herdr: one trigger key, then one keystroke per action — no typing, no Enter.

raghu-nandan-bs/herdr-deck-navigation.description: Replaces herdr's flat workspace/tab/pane navigator with a Deck view built to reach any pane fast without scrolling.

tomaszhanc/herdr-plugins.description: A personal monorepo of herdr plugins, each living in its own folder with a herdr-plugin.toml manifest and an executable.
